correctness.finding: The six-component computation checks exactly. The incidence is E_i-D_j iff i!=j. At P=(q_1,q_0,q_1), the affine Jacobian has rank exactly 4, hence tangent dimension 2 versus local dimension 1. The committed verification script and log agree.
